en.name: Hindu
en.ability: The first 4 players to die are immediately reincarnated as Travellers of the same alignment.
en.flavor: चत्वारो मृत्युमध्ये पतन्ति, चत्वारो यात्री पुनरुद्गताः। चत्वारो धर्मे स्थितचित्तवृत्तेः, चत्वार एषां न पुनः क्षयः॥

revisions.v1: The first 4 players to die are immediately reincarnated as Travellers of the same alignment.
